title: mill operation
description: Size reduction as a breakage population balance on the case's size grid (`sizeGrid {}` in system/flowsheetDict; Austin 1971). The unit's `model` word selects the SELECTION function (austin, herbstFuerstenau, vogelPeukert); `breakage { model austin; }` the breakage function. Plug flow or perfectly mixed. Exactly one of W_shaft and specificEnergy; the mill is adiabatic and its outlet temperature is the result. Bond's third theory is an optional cross-check printed beside the population-balance energy, never instead of it.

W_shaft.title: Net shaft power
W_shaft.description: The power drawn by the mill. Give this OR specificEnergy, never both: the other follows from the solids flow.

specificEnergy.title: Specific energy
specificEnergy.description: Energy per kg of solids (kWh/t is accepted). For herbstFuerstenau it is what breaks the particles; for the rate laws it is only priced as heat.

residence.title: Residence-time model
residence.description: plugFlow: p = exp(M) f, a batch mill ground for tau (Austin 1971 eq. 49). perfectlyMixed: p_i (1 + kappa_i) = f_i + sum b_ij kappa_j p_j (eq. 44a). Default plugFlow, said in the run.

residenceTime.title: Mean residence time
residenceTime.description: For the RATE laws (austin, vogelPeukert): tau. Give this OR holdup.

holdup.title: Solids hold-up
holdup.description: Solids mass in the mill; tau = holdup / solids flow (Austin 1971 eq. 46). Give this OR residenceTime.

selection.title: Selection-function parameters
selection.description: The parameters of the law the unit's `model` word names. austin: S1, x1, alpha, mu, Lambda. herbstFuerstenau: S1E, x1, zeta1, zeta2. vogelPeukert: fMat, xWmMin, Wkin, stressFrequency, impacts.

mu.title: Size of the maximum (austin)
mu.description: Absent: the pure power law (Herbst & Fuerstenau 1980 eq. 22).

S1E.title: Energy-specific rate at x1 (herbstFuerstenau)
S1E.description: In t/kWh as the literature reports it.

zeta2.title: Quadratic log-size coefficient (herbstFuerstenau)
zeta2.description: Must be <= 0 (a maximum, not a minimum).

breakage.title: Breakage function
breakage.description: B(u) = phi u^gamma + (1 - phi) u^beta, u = x/y (King 2001 eq. 5.78).

bond.title: Bond cross-check (optional)
bond.description: W = 10 Wi (1/sqrt(P80) - 1/sqrt(F80)) on the run's own F80 and P80, printed beside the population-balance energy with their ratio and the operating work index.

workIndex.title: Bond work index
workIndex.description: kWh/shortTon is accepted (Bond's own unit; Wills Table 5.1: limestone 12.74).
